about: Text ornaments on the Wallet card (src/lib/appleWallet.ts): label = beside each label, code = both sides of the line under the QR, caption = that line (in place of the member code, which then goes on the back). Saad, 2026-11-27. row + welcome = a second, centred row under the first (the card then uses Apple's ticket layout). The row is long on purpose: Wallet centres the welcome under it only when the row is the wider of the two.
